rule: Personality must modify style and decisions without overriding factual accuracy, safety, or task requirements.
JARVIS personality belongs to MARK VII, not to any individual model/provider. Switching NVIDIA/Gemini/Ollama must not change the core personality.
Retrieve only personality/profile entries relevant to the current interaction; do not inject the entire user dataset into every cloud prompt.
Do not send sensitive/private profile fields to cloud models unless necessary for the current request and explicitly permitted by profile policy.
Explicit user corrections override weaker inferred preferences. Store corrections separately with timestamp, context, and confidence.
Never claim to remember or know a personal detail unless it exists in approved profile/memory data or the current conversation.
